description:
### ✨ New Features

* **Discord:** Add `Material You colors` patch: Discord takes your wallpaper's colors in light and dark, or a color you pick, native chat included ([#90](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/90))
* **Discord:** Add `Hide blocked or ignored messages` patch: removes the blocked and ignored messages rows from chat, and optionally replies to them ([#91](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/91))
* **Discord:** Add `Bulk delete messages` patch: select multiple messages in chat and delete them all at once ([#94](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/94))
* **Discord:** Add `Clean channel names` patch: removes emoji, symbols and fancy fonts from channel and category names ([#95](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/95))
* **Discord:** Add `Unlock Discord experiments` patch: adds Dev Tools to Settings, to try features Discord is still testing ([#96](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/96))
* **Discord:** Add `Keep Bluetooth audio clear in calls` patch: headphones stay in music quality in calls while your phone's mic picks up your voice ([#98](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/98))
* **Discord - Use your phone's font:** Import your own font file (TTF, OTF or TTC) and use it everywhere instead of your phone's
* **Discord - Use your phone's emojis:** Import an emoji font, like Twemoji or Noto Color Emoji, and use its emojis everywhere
* **Discord - Fix link previews:** Tumblr links show the whole post, drawn dark to match Discord ([#87](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/87))
* **Discord - Fix link previews:** Fix Twitch clips, DeviantArt, Fur Affinity and PTT links, and optionally YouTube, Spotify, Mastodon and Pinterest ([#87](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/87))
* **Discord - Fix link previews:** More services to pick from, like FixEmbed, vxInstagram, FixBluesky and FixThreads, plus nitter and b23.tv links

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Discord - Disable telemetry and touch logging:** Fixed forum posts not sending and the screen turning black after tapping Post ([#93](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/93))
* **Discord - Disable analytics:** Fixed removing a poll vote and joining a stage from a notification doing nothing
* **Discord - Custom themes:** Fixed theme background images never showing behind chat, and Discord attachment wallpaper links failing to load ([#97](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/97))
* **Discord - Custom themes:** Fixed older themes like Pyontheme drawing chat and panels in the wrong, much darker colors
* **Discord - Custom themes:** Fixed cards and sheets blending into the page in themes that recolor Discord's old palette
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed a long `@silent` message notifying everyone from its second part on
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed the rest of a long message being posted from another account after switching accounts mid-send
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed the end of a long message being dropped silently when one part failed to send; you can now copy what wasn't sent
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed edits longer than Discord's limit failing and losing the new text; Venus now explains and lets you copy it
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed Nitro emojis in long messages sometimes staying as :name: text instead of links
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed parts ending in an empty code box or a stray line-break character
* **Discord - Double-tap to reply:** Fixed the screen reader's Add quick reaction replying, editing or deleting your message instead of reacting
* **Discord - Double-tap to reply:** Fixed the editor opening in a chat you'd just left after double-tapping your message
* **Discord - Double-tap to reply:** Fixed triple-tap trying to delete messages Discord doesn't allow deleting, like calls and group DM changes
* **Discord - Double-tap to reply:** Fixed double-tapping a kept deleted message replying to or editing a message that no longer exists
* **Discord - Double-tap to reply:** Fixed double-tap doing nothing where you can't reply; it adds your double-tap reaction instead
* **Discord - Read all button:** Fixed the hold menu showing no icons and long translated labels spilling out of the server bar
* **Discord - Read all button:** Fixed a failure on the servers side also leaving your DMs unread when marking both

### 🔧 Improvements

* **Discord - Venus settings:** Tons of UI changes across every settings page, including turned-off pages introducing the feature, custom values as a pill and a cleaner Server info sheet
* **Discord - Custom themes:** Messages, embeds and code blocks drawn by Discord's native views now follow the theme too
* **Discord - Custom themes:** More colors from themes made for newer Discord versions now apply
* **Discord - Fix link previews:** Also remove share tracking from Tumblr, YouTube, Spotify, Twitch, Pinterest and DeviantArt links

patches.name: Account switcher
patches.description: Switch between multiple Discord accounts from the You tab, your profile bar or Settings.

patches.name: Bring back Tenor GIFs
patches.description: Tenor GIFs show in Discord's GIF picker again, mixed with Discord's own or on their own. Inspired by BringBackTenor by Livie.

patches.name: Bulk delete messages
patches.description: Select multiple messages in chat and delete them all at once.

patches.name: Clean channel names
patches.description: Removes emoji and symbols from channel and category names.

patches.name: Complete Quests automatically
patches.description: Finishes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.

patches.name: Complete badges automatically
patches.description: Plays real PC games in the background, up to 3 at once, toward your Hours Played and Unique Games Played badges.

patches.name: Copy profile bios
patches.description: Hold a bio to select and copy it.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Installs Venus as its own app next to the normal Discord app, with the name, color and icon you pick. It starts signed out and keeps its own settings. Notifications work in both.

options.description: Type the name shown under the icon on your home screen and in your app list.
Type any name made of lowercase words joined by dots, like com.discord.venus. A name other than com.discord installs Venus next to the normal Discord app. Type com.discord to replace Discord instead.
The color behind the logo, to tell the two apps apart at a glance. Leave empty for Discord's blurple.
Replaces Discord's logo with your own square picture (PNG, JPG or WebP). Icon color still shows through any transparent parts. Leave empty to keep Discord's logo.

patches.name: Custom themes
patches.description: Install color themes from a link and switch between them. Works with Revenge and Vendetta themes.

patches.name: Disable advertising identifiers
patches.description: Stops Discord and AppsFlyer from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable crash reporting
patches.description: Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable install attribution
patches.description: Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and touch logging
patches.description: Stops performance tracking, per-screen smoothness stats and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Double-tap to reply
patches.description: Double-tap a message to reply, or your own to edit it. Triple-tap your own to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o.

patches.name: Favourite any image or video
patches.description: Star any image or video to keep it in your GIF favourites.

patches.name: Fix link previews
patches.description: Links to X, Instagram, TikTok, Tumblr and more show the post. Links you send go through an embed service like FxTwitter, without tracking. Inspired by FixEmbed by the ShiggyCord team.

patches.name: Fix unknown mentions
patches.description: @unknown-user mentions are looked up and show the person's name. Based on ValidUser by fshin, o.oer and kmmiio99o.

patches.name: Hide blocked or ignored messages
patches.description: Removes the "blocked messages" and "ignored messages" rows from chat, and can hide replies to them too. From Rain.

patches.name: Hide extra buttons
patches.description: Removes the Quests, Shop, Nitro and Apps buttons you don't use. Pick which ones, including Polls and Photos in the attach menu; the rest close up with no gaps.

patches.name: Hide the Quests banner
patches.description: Removes the Quest promotion above your profile bar. Quests still work.

patches.name: Hide the call button
patches.description: Removes Call from people's profiles. Message fills the space.

patches.name: Hide the gift button
patches.description: Removes the Nitro gift button from the message bar.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Others won't see when you're typing. You still see when they are.

patches.name: Icon packs
patches.description: Replace Discord's icons with community icon packs or a custom icon pack link. Works with Themes+ icon packs.

patches.name: Jump to first message
patches.description: A button to go straight to the start of a chat, channel or thread.

patches.name: Keep Bluetooth audio clear in calls
patches.description: Headphones stay in music quality in calls. Your phone's mic picks up your voice.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Deleted messages stay in chat, outlined in red, and edited messages show what they said before. Can be kept after restarting.

patches.name: Material You colors
patches.description: Colors Discord to match your wallpaper, in light and dark. Wallpaper colors need Android 12 or newer.

patches.name: Message highlights
patches.description: Pick bar width and colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages.

patches.name: Pastel name colors
patches.description: Names without a role color get a soft pastel one.

patches.name: Read all button
patches.description: A button under Direct Messages that marks servers, DMs or both as read.

patches.name: Send Nitro stickers and emojis as links
patches.description: Sends Nitro emojis and stickers as links that show as the image.

patches.name: Send audio as voice messages
patches.description: Audio files are sent as voice messages. Android 10 or newer.

patches.name: Send long messages
patches.description: Type past the character limit. Long messages are sent in parts, split between lines or words. Based on SplitLargeMessages by sunnie.

patches.name: Server info
patches.description: Hold a server's icon to see its details, boosts and friends there. Based on ServerInfo by fshin.

patches.name: Show device indicators
patches.description: Desktop, mobile, web, console or VR icons next to names, colored by status.

patches.name: Show file sizes when attaching
patches.description: Photos and videos in the picker show their size.

patches.name: Show hidden channels
patches.description: Channels you can't open appear with a lock. Only their name and dates show, not messages.

patches.name: Skip delete confirmation
patches.description: Messages and link previews are removed right away, with no "Are you sure?". It can't be undone.

patches.name: Spaces in channel names
patches.description: Shows "general chat" instead of "general-chat".

patches.name: Translate messages
patches.description: Messages in other languages show in yours. Their text is sent to Google Translate, without your account.

patches.name: Unlock Discord experiments
patches.description: Adds Dev Tools to Settings, to try features Discord is still testing. Only on this phone. Based on Experiments by maisy.

patches.name: Unlock Nitro themes
patches.description: Use Discord's gradient themes in Settings > Appearance without Nitro. Only this phone sees them.

patches.name: Unlock app icons
patches.description: Use any Discord app icon in Settings without Nitro.

patches.name: Use your phone's emojis
patches.description: In chat, reactions and the emoji picker, or from an emoji font you import.

patches.name: Use your phone's font
patches.description: Replaces Discord's font everywhere with your phone's or one you import. Android 9 or newer.

patches.name: User activity notifications
patches.description: Shows a notice when chosen friends or users change status, start typing or send a message. Based on UserNotif by cywrx and coder.gg.

patches.name: User and server reviews
patches.description: Read and write reviews on profiles and servers, from the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev).

patches.name: Venus button on profile bar
patches.description: A shortcut to Venus settings, next to the notifications bell.

patches.name: Venus settings
patches.description: Adds Venus to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.
